October 21

14 And death and hell were cast into the lake of fire. This is the second death. 15 And whosoever was not found written in the book of life was cast into the lake of fire. (Revelation 20:14-15 KJV)

This is at the end of the judgment of God upon the world. Even death and hell will be cast into the lake of fire (Revelation 20:10), and there will never be death again. This White Throne Judgment ends in the second death, for those not found in the book of life, which is not the end of existence for their souls, but is the beginning of eternity in torment, being forever in the lake of fire along with the devil and his angels. If this doesn’t make you want to be born again, and saved, then I don’t know what would. Praise God that His children will not have to be judged, and punished, along with the non-believers.

There is really a book of life in heaven (Revelation 3:5), and when a person gets saved and born again here on earth, then their name gets written in this book of life. If your name is in this book, then you will not be judged and thrown into the lake of fire by God, but will get to be with Jesus, and the Father, on the new earth forever. The only way your name can be blotted out of the book of life (Revelation 3:5), once in there, is for you to become a reprobate by renouncing your faith in Jesus as your Lord, or committing blasphemy against the Holy Ghost (Matthew 12:31-32). Only a mature Christian can renounce their salvation and be blotted out of the book of life. Blasphemy against the Holy Ghost is a willful refusal to obey the command of the Holy Ghost (Hebrews 5:9), or blaming the Holy Ghost for actions of the devil, or giving credit to the devil for what the Holy Ghost does. Lord, help me to always obey your commands, that I may stay in the book of life. For more info on the End Times and Blasphemy against the Holy Ghost see our “New Revelations” page on our website.

Devotional by Pastor Joe W. Green, www.Infinite-Faith.com
